case_number: 2025 INSC 227; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. OF 2025 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (C) NOS.1073-1074 OF 2023)
summary: Will revocation dispute; Letters of Administration revoked under Indian Succession Act s.263; High Court erred in raising limitation under Limitation Act Art.137 suo moto; no objection on limitation raised before District Court, thus no issue or evidence on this aspect; appeals allowed, High Court order set aside; remanded for merits-only reconsideration without limitation plea; reserved all contentions on merits to be heard afresh.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure 1908 Order IX Rule 13
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court order dated 10.10.2022 setting aside District Court's revocation of Letters of Administration set aside; remanded to High Court to reconsider appeals on merits alone without addressing limitation.
